decision.reason: The frozen enterprise Knowledge corpus has no source-bound Tag or Graph projection. A keyword-derived tag heuristic would not be the governed PAW Tag system and cannot support a fair replacement claim.
decision.nextGate: Build an enterprise graph whose active nodes and edges bind sourceChunkId, evidenceSpan, contentHash and revision; then compare no-rerank, Qwen3 and Graph+Tag on the same candidate pool and final depth.

claim.allowed: A source-grounded Validation readiness audit found zero enterprise Knowledge graph rows and no Tag identity on 5,101 documents and 29,846 chunks, so Graph+Tag was not scored against Qwen3. The measured Qwen3 reference remains MRR 0.867, nDCG@10 0.887 and Recall@10 0.955 on 16 Validation queries.
claim.forbidden: Graph+Tag is slower, worse, better, or equivalent to Qwen3; Held-out passed; the existing Memory Tag graph can directly rank enterprise chunks; or a blocked readiness audit is a completed A/B.
